chapters.title: Code World Model · Cloud-sea harbor
chapters.credit: Code World Model · Yiwen Chen, Guosheng Lin, Chi Zhang · Official research demo
chapters.scope: Prerecorded rendered observation from a framework where executable code maintains persistent world state and a proxy controls MiniMax-H3 output. The WASD overlay is preserved. This is an official research recording, not a live model or a complete publicly playable game.
chapters.limits: The public repository contains inference components; the underlying closed-source game foundation and proxy-generation tools are not released. See ENVIRONMENT.md.
chapters.license: The video dataset card has no explicit footage redistribution license. Apache-2.0 for source code does not establish a media license.
